No. IRDA/Reg/4/87/2014.—** In exercise of the powers conferred by sections 42, 64UM and 114A of the Insurance Act, 1938 (4 of 1938) read with section 14 and 26 of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999 (41 of 1999), the Authority, in consultation with the Insurance Advisory Committee, hereby makes the following regulations to further amend the Insurance Surveyors and Loss Assessors (Licensing, Professional Requirements and Code of Conduct) Regulations, 2000, namely: I. (i) These regulations may be called the Insurance Surveyors and Loss Assessors (Licensing, Professional Requirements and Code of Conduct) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2013. - (ii) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 2. Regulation 5 is substituted by the following : - (i) The fee payable to the Authority by fresh applicants for grant of licence to act as surveyors and loss assessors shall be one thousand Rupees notwithstanding the membership level. - (ii) Grant of licence is subject to fulfilment of requirements stated under Regulation 3 or 4 of IRDA Surveyor Regulations, 2000 as the case may be, as amended from time to time. - (iii) Payment of fees through online payment- net banking in Surveyor Licensing Portal considered as one of the modes of payment. 3. In regulation 7 (1) (b) the words “two hundred rupees”shall be substituted by the words “one hundred rupees” 4. The S. No. 13 of the Schedule, FORM – IRDA – 1 – AF – “Application for a Licence to act as Surveyor and Loss Assessor (Individual)”shall be substituted by the following: Fee Payment: NET BANKING/DEMAND DRAFT/NEFT/RTGS Fee applicable for all Surveyor categories Category of surveyor and loss assessor based on the membership Amount payable by individuals surveyor and Loss Assessor allotted by the Institute Fellow member Rs. 1000 + Applicable Service Tax Associate Member Licentiate Member 5. In S. No. 5 of FORM – IRDA – 3- AF–“Application from a Firm or Company for a licence to act as Surveyor and Loss Assessor”, the portion stipulating for Fee Payment shall be substituted as under : • Fee Payment: Net Banking /Demand Draft/NEFT/RTGS Fee applicable for all Surveyor categories Highest level of membership of any of the Director/Partner of the Amount payable by individuals surveyor and Loss Assessor company/Firm Fellow Member Rs. 1000 + Applicable Service Tax Associate Member Licentiate Member 6. In S. NO. 8 of FORM - IRDA - 5 AF – “Application for Renewal of a Licence to act as surveyor and Loss Assessor” – the amount of Rs. 200 wherever appearing shall be substituted by Rs. 100/- plus applicable service tax **.** 7. In S. No. 1 & 2 of the Notes of FORM – IRDA – 6AF – “Application from a Firm or Company for renewal of a Licence to act as a Surveyor and Loss Assessor”, the amount of Rs. 200/- wherever appearing shall be substituted by Rs. 100/- plus applicable service tax. [ADVT. III/4/161/13/Exty.] Printed by the Manager, Government of India Press, Ring Road, Mayapuri, New Delhi-110064 and Published by the Controller of Publications, Delhi-110054

chunks.content:
**F. No. IRDA/Reg/4/87/2014.—** In exercise of the powers conferred by sections 42, 64UM and 114A of the Insurance Act, 1938 (4 of 1938) read with section 14 and 26 of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999 (41 of 1999), the Authority, in consultation with the Insurance Advisory Committee, hereby makes the following regulations to further amend the Insurance Surveyors and Loss Assessors (Licensing, Professional Requirements and Code of Conduct) Regulations, 2000, namely: 

I.       (i)  These regulations may be called the Insurance Surveyors and Loss Assessors (Licensing, Professional Requirements and Code of Conduct) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2013. 

   - (ii)  They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 

2.  Regulation 5 is substituted by the following : 

   - (i) The fee payable to the Authority by fresh applicants for grant of licence to act as surveyors and loss assessors shall be one thousand Rupees notwithstanding the membership level. 

   - (ii) Grant of licence is subject to fulfilment of requirements stated under Regulation 3 or 4 of IRDA Surveyor Regulations, 2000 as the case may be, as amended from time to time. 

   - (iii) Payment of fees through online payment- net banking in Surveyor Licensing Portal considered as one of the modes of payment. 

3.  In regulation 7 (1) (b) the words “two hundred rupees”shall be substituted by the words “one hundred rupees” 

4. The S. No. 13 of the Schedule, FORM – IRDA – 1 – AF – “Application for a Licence to act as Surveyor and Loss Assessor (Individual)”shall be substituted by the following:

Category of surveyor and loss assessor based on the membership Amount payable by individuals surveyor and Loss Assessor allotted by the Institute Fellow member Rs.
